# BabelWise — Design Notes

## Source
- ColorLib: Lingua (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/lingua/)
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/lingua/

## Section order
1. Top Bar (phone, language selector, social icons)
2. Navbar (logo, nav links, search icon, dark bg)
3. Hero (bg image, "Learn Languages Easily", "get started")
4. Language Slider (9 language items in carousel)
5. Popular Courses (course cards with vocabulary, author, language tag, price)
6. Instructors (3 profiles, circular avatars, dark bg)
7. Milestones (stat counters)
8. Newsletter (subscribe form, dark bg)
9. Blog (blog posts)
10. Footer (4 columns, dark bg, Component Dock)

## Tokens
- Primary: #2e21df (purple-blue) | Accent: #4f47e2
- Muted: #7c7c7c, #a5a5a5 | Light bg: #f8f8f8
- Fonts: Poppins (headings), Montserrat (body)
- Buttons: 0px (square) | Avatars: 50%
